basis: The App Store privacy label for this app and the app's App Store description. Draft prepared 10 November 2026; awaiting the developer's confirmation.
summary: Babi collects no data. It has no account and no analytics. Your baby's details stay in your own iCloud, or only on your device if you prefer.
onDevice: Your baby's details, lists, logs and settings: in your own iCloud account or only on your device
The day's handoff card and packing lists

permissions.name: Location (approximate)
permissions.why: To look up local weather, UV and air quality. You can pick a city by hand instead and never grant it.

permissions.name: Apple Home
permissions.why: Only if you choose to read room temperature from a sensor in Apple Home.

permissions.name: Notifications
permissions.why: For reminders such as the sunscreen reminder in the Live Activity.

services.name: Weather, UV and air-quality data
services.what: Looked up for your approximate location or the city you choose.

purchases: Babi+ is sold through the App Store as a subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase, shareable with Family Sharing. Apple handles payment.
extra: Sharing with a partner or grandparent happens through iCloud sharing that you start and control.
Babi does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment.
